body_markdown:
**PANAMA CITY BEACH, FL** (September 3, 2026)— MarineMax Panama City Beach is once again opening its showroom to say thank you to the men and women who serve and protect our community. The dealership will host its 2nd Annual Heroes & Friends Appreciation Luncheon on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, from 11:00 am to 1:00 pm, at MarineMax Panama City Beach, 3605 Thomas Drive, Panama City Beach, FL 32408.


The free luncheon is a heartfelt tribute to Bay County’s law enforcement officers, firefighters, emergency medical personnel, and other community heroes who show up every day to keep Panama City Beach safe. First responders are invited to attend, and the broader community is encouraged to join in celebrating them.


"MarineMax Panama City Beach is proud to partner with our sponsors for the second annual Heroes and Friends Appreciation Lunch," said Robert Stirling, General Manager of MarineMax Panama City Beach. "This event is a small way for us to thank the first responders who serve and protect our community, on land and on the water. We're grateful for their dedication and honored to celebrate them."


Guests can look forward to a full luncheon, fellowship, and a genuine expression of gratitude from MarineMax Panama City Beach and event partners Wicked Wheel and Rock Pepsi.


Event Details:


- **What** : 2nd Annual Heroes & Friends Appreciation Luncheon


- **When** : Wednesday, September 9, 2026 | 11:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.


- **Where** : MarineMax Panama City Beach, 3605 Thomas Drive, Panama City Beach, FL 32408


- **Who** : Open to local first responders and the Panama City Beach community


Cost: Free to attend


Bay County first responders and community members are encouraged to RSVP in advance[here](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2nd-annual-heros-and-friends-appreciation-lunch-tickets-1999100908632?aff=oddtdtcreator) .
